title: India signs the 10-nation AI supply chain pact
takeaways: 10 governments signed the San Francisco Declaration on 15 Nov 2026.
India's 12 approved chip projects total ₹1.64 lakh crore.
Chip (IC) imports hit $12.62 billion in April–December 2025.
Electronics exports rose 24% to $47.96 billion in FY26.
85% of a fab project's cost is still imported.
source_note: Sources: PTI/Business Standard; PIB; NewsBytes; KNN; Fab Economics via Business Today
